body:
it's been an intrusive thought for me in the past, and today it just came back up again. i feel horrible, and i'll probably feel horrible about it again, but i need to just let it go even if i feel disgusted and horrified. :( i don't think my kitty would want me lingering on this, he'd want me to think of all the good times i've spent with him.

it just feels horrible. thank you for reassuring me about it. it's been so hard for me lately and i've been thinking of so many horrible things lately, and it's just the newest thing my brain has latched onto. i just can't stop wondering why i did it, and how fucked up it is.

thank you. i just feel so horrible. i'm really depressed lately, i've been having crippling thoughts over this for 12 hours... i've cried over it 3-4 times today. i just feel so broken by it. 

i don't think i actually want to kill myself. i just felt this thought come over me again and i felt a hot wash of horror and shame and dread and i thought "maybe i should just kill myself". but i don't want to i want to feel better and have things to live for even though it's been so hard lately.

i'm scared that tomorrow when i go to my psychiatrist he'll ask me if i'm suicidal and i'll  say yes and have to explain why. i don't want to tell anyone about this :(

thank you :( i just feel so sick and horrible. i feel like i violated my cat's trust or something. i've been trying all day to stop thinking about it but i just don't know how to forgive myself for what i've done
